repos_data.description: 🔊 Text-to-Speech MCP plugin for Claude Code - hear audio feedback while coding (OpenAI TTS)
Natural voice conversations with Claude Code
hns is a speech-to-text CLI tool to transcribe your voice from your microphone directly to clipboard. Integrate hns with Claude Code, Ollama, LLM, and more CLI tools for powerful workflows.
An MCP server that lets Claude Code recall past conversations from any project, as clean compact Markdown.

Let your AI agent call your phone and talk to you — MCP servers for live, interruptible voice calls + tiered alerts, using free self-hosted pieces (pjsua2 + whisper.cpp + Linphone). No paid telephony, no extra API key.
Open-source real-time Voice AI infrastructure in Go. Stream audio via WebRTC or WebSocket, connect STT → LLM → TTS pipelines, and build scalable voice agents and conversational AI applications.
MCP Server for Brainiall Speech AI - pronunciation assessment, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech
Beautiful Claude Code Chat Interface for VS Code
Simple curl script to play aloud what you type, useful if your voice is suddenly broken.
MCP server with persistent memory + FTS5 search for Claude Code conversation history. Index your ~/.claude/projects/, expose 10 MCP tools, browse via web UI. MIT-licensed.

45+ tips for getting the most out of Claude Code, from basics to advanced - includes a custom status line script and Claude Code running itself in a container. Also includes the dx plugin: skills for everyday dev workflows.

repo_meta_data.description: Talk to Claude Code instead of typing: a voice daemon + dashboard that records you, transcribes, routes to your agent sessions, and speaks the replies back - with per-voice avatars, push-to-talk hotkeys, and a live conversation HUD
